column1: I’m happy to share that our project, The Desk, was selected as a Semi-Finalist at the ET-AI Hackathon 2026! Built with my teammate Atrijaa Biswas ,The Desk is an AI-powered platform that converts live global news headlines into simple Hindi explainers and structured briefings, making complex news accessible to everyone. This recognition from The Economic Times was a proud moment for us, and it continues to inspire our work.
